jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You are ready to work in the fixed afternoon shift.

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

Our distinguished firm, with a team of 900 advisors across the Benelux, Switzerland, and global financial centers, serves as the preferred legal and tax partner for businesses in the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, and Switzerland.

Clients benefit from personalized counsel, leveraging our full-service approach, sector-specific expertise, and extensive market knowledge.

Jobomschrijving

What will be your responsibilities?

• Facilitate the incorporation of new clients and commencement of matters.
• Aid in the arrangement and subsequent follow-up of invoicing procedures.
• Supervise the adherence to Know Your Client (KYC) identification protocols.
• Track and ensure compliance with Bar points.
• Handle document archiving, uphold database accuracy, and manage printing responsibilities.
• Deliver comprehensive administrative assistance, encompassing the creation of PowerPoint presentations, coordinating travel logistics, and overseeing timesheet management.
• Effectively organize schedules, arrange appointments with clients and colleagues, and manage logistics for recruitment interviews.
• Serve as a substitute for other administrative assistants when necessary.

can you recognise yourself in this?

• Demonstrate a proficient command of English and possess a solid passive understanding of either Dutch or French.
• Hold a high school diploma, a bachelor's degree (although not obligatory), or can present equivalent work experience.
• Exhibit a comprehensive understanding of MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• Display an inclination for financial and billing systems, expressing a genuine enjoyment of numerical work.
• Showcase robust organizational skills, characterized by a high degree of structure and the ability to effectively prioritize tasks.
• Set yourself apart through precision, accuracy, and a commitment to thoroughness in your work.
• Proactively approach tasks with a customer-centric and service-oriented mindset.
• Flourish in a collaborative team-oriented environment.

About this job
For a foodcompany in Meulebeke, we are looking for a line supervisor for a 2-shift schedule.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

Our client is seeking an experienced Customer Service Manager to oversee customer service operations, drive continuous improvement, and lead a high-performing team.

As a Customer Service Manager your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.
• Monitor and improve operational processes to ensure seamless service delivery.
• Handle escalated customer issues and provide effective resolutions.
• Analyse customer feedback and data to identify areas for improvement.
• Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards.
• Collaborate with other departments to align customer service goals with overall business objectives.

A successful Customer Service Manager should have:

• Strong background in change management and organizational transformation

The Finance Officer will handle key accounting and finance tasks, ensuring accurate financial records and compliance with regulations. 

Client Details

The company is located in Brussels.

Description

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in audits and implement recommendations as required.
• Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making.

A successful Finance Officer should have:

• Residence in Brussels/Belgium.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for growing the company's presence in Belgium by identifying opportunities, managing client portfolios, and driving commercial success.

Client Details

Join an innovative and fast-growing technology company that helps organizations optimize their digital document and information management processes. With a strong reputation in its sector and a customer-centric approach, the company continues to expand its presence across the Belgian market.

Description

• Develop and expand the Belgian market through active business development.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
• Identify client needs and propose tailored solutions.
• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract negotiation.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.
• Monitor market trends and identify new growth opportunities.
• Represent the company during client meetings and networking events.

• Proven experience in a B2B Account Management or Business Development role.

• Comfortable developing a market and creating business opportunities.

We are currently looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist, fluent in French and English, to join a team based in Brussels.

In this temporary assignment, you will play a key role in supporting the full recruitment cycle within the professional services sector. Your responsibilities will include sourcing talent, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring an efficient and positive hiring process.

Client Details

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Description

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

 

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required

• Available immediately

• Handle correspondence, emails, and phone calls in German and English

Our client is a rapidly growing organization active in the healthcare sector and part of a large international group. Despite its strong backing, the company maintains an entrepreneurial, start-up-like environment with significant transformation projects underway.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Payroll & Administration Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage the monthly payroll process in collaboration with the social secretariat.
• Ensure accurate payroll closures and perform payroll validations.
• Compare and reconcile time management and payroll data.
• Handle payroll corrections and follow-up actions where necessary.
• Support HR administration activities, including contracts, onboarding, and offboarding.
• Coordinate payroll-related queries through the ticketing system and liaise with internal stakeholders.
• Provide support on HR and payroll projects across multiple legal entities and clinics.

A successful Freelance Payroll & Administration Officer should have:

• Proven experience in end-to-end payroll administration.
• Strong knowledge of Belgian payroll and social legislation.
• Experience working with social secretariats and payroll providers.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, less structured, entrepreneurial environment.
• Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Hands-on mentality and ability to work independently.
• Fluent in Dutch with a good command of English; French is a plus.
• Experience with Workday, ADP, SAP, or similar systems is considered an asset.

Our client is a leading international healthcare and pharmaceutical services organization, supporting customers worldwide through specialized logistics and supply chain solutions.

Jobomschrijving

• Monitor customs declarations to ensure compliance with customs regulations and procedures.
• Manage and update electronic transit records and customs documentation.
• Prepare supplementary customs declarations for import shipments.
• Communicate with customs authorities, regulatory bodies, clients, and internal stakeholders.
• Resolve customs-related queries and support smooth import operations.
• Ensure accurate record-keeping and maintain high-quality administrative standards.
• Prioritize multiple tasks and timelines in a fast-paced logistics environment.
• Work with internal logistics and IT systems to process and track shipments

• First experience in logistics, customs, import/export, supply chain, or an administrative operational role.
• Strong administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English (written and spoken).
• Comfortable communicating with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Able to work independently while contributing effectively within a team.
• Organized, proactive, and capable of managing priorities under pressure.

Our client is an international organization active in the energy sector.

Jobomschrijving

• SAP CO and allocation cycles: Maintain, execute, review and troubleshoot cost allocation cycles, including assessments and distributions across cost centres, activities, departments, products and other relevant dimensions.
• Management accounting: Support the design and consistent application of analytical accounting principles, cost-centre structures, cost-driver logic and allocation methodologies.
• Direct and indirect costs: Analyse cost flows, distinguish direct from indirect costs, validate allocation keys and ensure that costs are assigned consistently and transparently.
• Reporting and analysis: Develop and maintain management reports; analyse actual results against budget, forecast and prior periods; investigate and explain significant variances.
• Data quality and reconciliation: Consolidate, review and validate large volumes of financial and operational data; perform reconciliations between SAP, management reporting and accounting records.
• Excel-based modelling: Build and maintain efficient reporting tools and analyses using advanced formulas, PivotTables, lookups and structured datasets.
• Process improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate reporting and allocation processes while strengthening controls and documentation.
• Management support: Prepare clear financial analyses and ad hoc reports for management and support stakeholders in understanding cost drivers and allocation outcomes.

• Professional experience: Relevant hands-on experience in controlling, management accounting, cost accounting or financial reporting, preferably within a complex international organization.
• Analytical accounting: A sound understanding of management accounting and cost-allocation concepts, or demonstrable experience and readiness to quickly deepen expertise in these areas.
• Excel: Advanced command of Microsoft Excel, especially PivotTables, formulas, lookups, data validation and analysis of large datasets. This is an essential requirement.
• Power BI: Experience with Power BI is a plus and will be positively valued.
Analytical mindset: Ability to understand and challenge complex cost flows, allocation keys and reporting logic, with strong attention to detail and data consistency.

• Ways of working: Structured, accurate, autonomous and pragmatic, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Finance and operational functions.
• Industry background: Experience in a company with manufacturing or production operations is a strong advantage, particularly in an industrial, energy, chemical or petrochemical environment.
• Languages: Fluent English is required. French, Dutch or Italian would be an asset.

Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!
 

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!
 

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:
 

 
• Manually picking orders
 
• Packing and labelling products
 
• Processing shipping documents
 
• Working with handheld scanners 
 

You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.
 

 
• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM
 
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs
 
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential
 
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training
 
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport
 
• You speak English fluently

jobs.occupation: Freelance IT Project Manager | Security & Integration
jobs.description:
Here, you assume end-to-end management of multiple complex infrastructure projects within a hybrid enterprise environment.You coordinate projects related to middleware, integration, automation, networking, and network security, ensuring that technical teams and vendors remain aligned. You translate the various project lines into concrete plans, milestones, and deliverables, and closely monitor these using tools including MS Project and Jira.You guide technical teams during implementations, migrations, and infrastructure changes, while monitoring schedules, scope, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies.You organize alignment and synchronization meetings, maintain coherence between different initiatives, and ensure transparent communication with stakeholders and management.Additionally, you oversee governance, documentation, compliance, and security requirements.

• +5y experience as Project Manager in IT-infra
• You are strong in stakeholder management and diplomacy
• Broad technical knowledge of infrastructure, cloud, middleware, integration, and security 
• Trilingual environment (English, Dutch & French): you should at least understand (not speak) them at a basic level and master one
